items.source: Return the configured ForwardedHeaderTransformer.
items.translation: 返回配置的ForwardedHeaderTransformer。

items.source: Configure the ForwardedHeaderTransformer for extracting and/or removing forwarded headers.
items.translation: 配置ForwardedHeaderTransformer以提取和/或移除转发头。

items.source: Uses of ForwardedHeaderTransformer in org.springframework.web.server.adapter
Implementations to adapt to the underlying org.springframework.http.client.reactive reactive HTTP adapter and HttpHandler.
items.translation: 用于适配底层 `org.springframework.http.client.reactive` 响应式 HTTP 适配器以及 HttpHandler 的实现。

items.source:
Enable processing of forwarded headers, either extracting and removing,
or remove only.
items.translation: 启用转发标头的处理，可选择提取并移除，或仅移除。
